adjudication.rationale:
In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`:
```ts
const isTeamAdminOrOwner =
  (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) &&
  (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0));
```
But the name and the subsequent permission gate (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`) imply an admin-OR-owner rule. Using `&&` narrows access to users who are both admin and owner, so a team admin who is not the owner will incorrectly be forbidden from adding guests.
